name: foundit_auto_apply
prompt:
The script output above is the JSON summary from the Foundit auto-apply run (foundit_auto_apply.py). Do not run anything yourself; only format that output for WhatsApp.

If "applied" has entries:
✅ Applied:
- <title> @ <company> (<location>, <experience>)
Omit the parenthesis entirely when location and experience are both null; never print the word None.

If "needs_review" has entries:
✋ Needs review (clicked apply, no confirmation):
- <title> @ <company>

If "failed" has entries:
❌ Failed:
- <title> @ <company> — <reason>

End with one line: **Foundit today: X applied, Y filtered**
Do NOT list the filtered jobs individually; there are usually 40+ and they are almost all experience-band rejections. Just the count.
If the output reports a login or session error: tell Vishal the Foundit session expired and he needs to log in again from a desktop session.
If nothing applied, nothing needs review and nothing failed: respond with exactly [SILENT].
